manifest.author: Bill Whalen
manifest.description: Drafts professional emails and sends via Microsoft Power Automate flow endpoint.
manifest.name: @discreetRappers/email_drafting_agent

attachments.description: Optional. List of attachment file names or identifiers.

bcc.description: Optional. List of email addresses to BCC.

body.description: The full body of the email. This can include any content the caller desires.

cc.description: Optional. List of email addresses to CC.

importance.description: Optional. Importance level of the email.

subject.description: The subject line of the email.

to.description: Email address of the primary recipient.
